profile.subtitleJa: ハモルの子として言及される人物。
profile.summaryJa: ヨシュア記24章32節は、ヤコブがハモルの子らから買った土地を「ハモルの子シェケムの土地」と呼びます。本文はシェケムをハモルの子として名指ししますが、人物としての生涯は記しません。
profile.historicalRoleJa: ハモルの子として本文に名が現れる人物。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 同じ語の出現だが、このIDの人物・集団を指す根拠がなく、本文では別の用法。原文: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
同じ語の出現だが、このIDの人物・集団を指す根拠がなく、本文では別の用法。原文: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.

同じ語の出現だが、このIDの人物・集団を指す根拠がなく、本文では別の用法。原文: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
同じ語の出現だが、このIDの人物・集団を指す根拠がなく、本文では別の用法。原文: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,

同じ語の出現だが、このIDの人物・集団を指す根拠がなく、本文では別の用法。原文: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.
同じ語の出現だが、このIDの人物・集団を指す根拠がなく、本文では別の用法。原文: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

review.identityCheckJa: Shechemの記事は同名都市の記事であり、ヨシュア24:32の「ハモルの子」個人の同一性を扱う記事ではないため採用しない。
review.spoilerCheckJa: 常時表示欄はヨシュア記初出JOS 24:32までの情報に限定し、後の事実は本文出現以後のknownByで分離。

wikipediaCheck.status: 名前一致だが対象未一致。専用の適合記事なしとは結論しない。
wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: ヨシュア記24:32はシェケムを埋葬地として用い、Wikipediaの該当節はハモルの子シェケムという同名異人。候補ページはリンクしない。
